text: The staff is very unhelpful and uninformed—some seemed to even be attempting to deny me care.  I’ve now shown up four different times and still haven’t received treatment, either because the wait times were hours long or the staff told me incorrect information.  I’m sorry public health care is in such a state.
Came for a health cert for drivers license. 360 baht. 30 min total process. Fast and efficient. Good English 👍 …

I visited for a vaccine and I had to spend 90 minutes here even if it wasn’t super busy. The shot itself took seconds. The pros are that it’s cheaper than a local hospital, where they wanted to charge me about 3 times what I paid here.

Best medical care I've had anywhere in Chiang Mai and I've been to both public and private hospitals. I'm an experienced American nurse
and found the diagnosis and treatment to be similar to that in the US but more polite and patient. American docs spend an average of 7 minutes with a patient! I had a urinary tract infection and the consultation,  tests and medicine cost 470 baht. I was extremely pleased.

Got redirected here from the main hospital for my 2nd rabies shot. Total Cost for the shot: 626 bhat. A little more expensive compared to my first shot in Pai. In and out in under 30 minutes, staff were friendly.
I noticed that the staff responsible for checking documents before clinic entry spoke in an unfriendly manner, which made the experience uncomfortable.

Went to suan dok hospital and they referred me here to get my medical certificate for driving license. As a foreigner they are quick to let you skip the queues, but you pay 3x the price that Thai pay.
They work quick and precise, only one problem I had is the price: it was 2x of what I had in private clinic a year ago for driver license health certificate.
If you are looking for cpap part, the pharmacy, Suandoc Health shop, has all the parts you need.
Fast and efficient. Went in for a medical certificate for driving license. 360 baht. 30 minutes.
They charge ×3 time then other private clinic for driving license medical certificate. I went there without looking up other reviews.
Iv been constipated for over two weeks and DR Am was able to help me with perfect English and teach me about my problem throughly, amazing service and extremely reasonably priced
Not trustworthy. Doctors in the 2nd treatment room are extremely impatience and extremely bad. The technique is very rude.
Fast , clean, very helpful.  Better than anything I've encountered in canada
fast, efficient, and cheap!

The queuing system inside is disorganized. Doctors spend too much time examining patients, causing morning appointments to drag into the afternoon. There are many examination rooms, but some cases requiring specialist consultations involve excessively long waits.

That old, short-haired female doctor should take a break! She's demoralizing to patients. Don't make me complain to the director! This is a government-sponsored clinic; patients pay monthly, and they only come for checkups occasionally. This isn't a free, indigent medical facility. Be friendly to the patients. If you don't want to talk or give advice, you should stay home!

I came to get a medical certificate and was told I needed a blood type test, but I had to wait in line to see the doctor before I could have my blood drawn. I'd already waited two hours, and after the blood test, I was told to wait another three to four hours. Even after four hours, I still didn't get the results. In short, I wasted a whole day just to get a medical certificate!!! Please improve your system. Making people wait all day like this is unacceptable.

The service is good. The number of people varies depending on the day and time. After the examination, if you need to have another appointment in another room, the doctor will schedule it for you immediately. The staff's tone of voice is okay, but it varies from person to person.
There were many people using the service, but what impressed me was that all the staff were polite. The inspection was moderately quick, not too slow.
I'm confused by the hospital's queue management system. Patients are randomly inserted into the queue. I've been waiting for more than 5 hours before seeing a doctor.
It's taking too long. I arrived at 9 AM and it's 8 PM now, and I still haven't left.
author_name: นิรันดร์ แซ่พ่าน

text: This was my first time using the service and I wasn't impressed with the nurse who called the queue number inside, which wasn't the ticket counter. The service wasn't nice and they gave advice in a loud voice. 😩 People who don't know aren't stupid. …
Clinics that accept social security patients are very busy, so you may have to wait a while if you come for treatment.

The 1:30 PM appointment slot is fake. For those who don't know, the appointment time is irrelevant. When you arrive at your scheduled time, they'll tell you that since you registered in the afternoon, you have to wait in line, which has been running since morning. There are over a hundred people in line, and we're currently at number 70... My God! ...So, I should say... don't bother arriving at the scheduled time on your appointment day. You can just queue up from the morning onwards...

I took a patient to their scheduled doctor's appointment and encountered a male doctor who spoke very rudely. I wish he had more professionalism and a better service mindset. Staff members like this will damage the hospital's image.
author_name: วัชรพล เตชะโสภณ

text:
The man working at counter number 2, wearing a black watch, had a rude attitude. You should be guiding patients, not speaking rudely to them. The documents have the doctor's handwriting and signature, as well as the social security signature. Your job is to deliver the referral documents to the doctor, not to scold or berate patients about the documents, which they don't know about. They came because of the referral document, and it's their first time!! They need to receive treatment according to the procedure from a specialist doctor under their social security benefits. {If you have a rude attitude in the service job, you shouldn't be working here.}
The doctors and nurses were very polite, giving advice to patients, having good interpersonal skills, and willingly assisting patients.

I feel terrible. Normally, waiting this long isn't a problem, but shouldn't the staff have informed and explained this from the start? I waited since morning, only to see a different doctor later that morning, and then the queue filled up again, making me wait until the afternoon. Is this the patient's fault? When I showed my displeasure, they spoke to me rudely. (If I were feeling well, I wouldn't be here.)
author_name: อารุณีย์ ลายใส

text: I used their services today around 7:35 AM. There was a female nurse and a dark-skinned male service staff member in room 108. The service was terrible; they were both unwilling to help and were both argumentative. Initially, there was only one nurse, and it was quite intense, but the male staff member came to help. I understand they were protecting her, but they should have done so in a proper way. Instead, they were trying to win the argument. This was while I was bringing my mother along; imagine what it would have been like if she had gone alone. I understand it's a service job, but if they're unwilling to do their job, they should resign and let someone with a better personality and a genuine desire to serve work take over. We are paying for our treatment; we aren't asking for anything free. Where can I file a complaint? Does anyone know? Please advise. I've already submitted a complaint form.
October 26, 2024: There's no parking at the clinic. I had to leave my things at this building and walk to the clinic.

The female staff member at the nursing counter spoke very rudely. People don't know everything; sometimes they could give better advice. The doctor, nurses, and pharmacist who dispensed the medication were excellent and provided great service. But the staff member at the nursing counter...?

(Some people), such as the male staff member wearing a black watch, had a tone and demeanor that seemed unwilling to provide service. When calling us into the examination room, instead of calling our name, they would look at us and indicate which room it was. This last request was only made once. However, the doctor was good and the female nurse spoke politely. Thank you.

Where can I file a complaint?
I had pulmonary tuberculosis two years ago and completed my six-month medication as prescribed by the doctor. I wanted to have a chest X-ray, but the nurse told …

Once again, I'm disappointed with this place. Today is Asalha Puja, and I had an appointment to pick up medication and see a doctor for a blood test at room 108. I called Suan Dok Hospital to ask if the Social Security office was open, and they said yes, so I went as scheduled. However, the staff at room 108 said the pharmacy was closed and there was no doctor. Since it's a holiday and there are fewer staff members, the clinic shouldn't be scheduling patients in the first place. Patients need to prepare for their doctor's appointments and medication pickups. This wastes my time today and other days. (Before going, I tried calling the number the Social Security clinic usually uses, but no one answered.) If the doctor and staff aren't available on holidays, they should just put up a notice saying they don't work on holidays. Don't bother coming on holidays.

First time here.
It was really quick.
But I'm not sure about the quality.
I informed them that two people in my household have influenza A.
It seems we might have caught it.
I'm starting to have mild symptoms, but no fever yet.
The doctor didn't test my saliva or nasal discharge, just gave me two packs of paracetamol.

If you want to get tested, I recommend Suan Dok Hospital; although there's a longer wait, they do a more thorough test.
If you're just getting tested to get medication, I recommend going to a pharmacy instead.

Right now, I have a fever and am about to go back to the hospital.
I shouldn't have wasted my time getting tested here.
author_name: มีนัท มีดี

text: For us, the doctors and staff here are great and very lovely. I had a check-up with Dr. Paitoon, who gave me excellent self-care advice and was very kind.

I came to get a medical certificate. It was very convenient. There weren't many people and the staff provided excellent service. It took about 40 minutes to complete. I parked at Suan Dok Park, walked across the skywalk to the end, and then went down the stairs and found it right away.
author_name: ปวีณ์นุช เอื้อแท้

text: I got a driver's license certificate for 360 baht. It's three times more expensive than at the hospital. I didn't like the place.
Terrible! Please improve your appointment booking system. For my annual health check-up, I had to wait in line for company groups, and they said there were no appointments available.
The man at the nursing counter in the screening area spoke very rudely and provided poor service. I forgave him the first time, but the second time was not okay. However, the other staff were good.
The service is very slow. The staff doesn't understand what they're saying. The doctors here are like medical students and don't seem confident.
I arrived at 3:30 PM and was told they were closed and not accepting patients. They should correct the opening and closing times on Google Maps from 4:00 PM to 3:30 PM. It was a waste of time.
The queue management system is very confusing. It's like sitting and waiting without any purpose.
The young man who handled registration provided excellent service and gave very helpful information. I was very impressed.
This is my first time here, and I didn't expect it to take this long.
The service was fast, the place was clean, and the staff provided good service.
author_name: บุญมี รีแล็กซ์

text: The service was convenient to use.
Clinic Building 108 accepts social security insurance for medical treatment.
This is my second time here, and the air conditioning is nice and cool.
Good service, short wait.
There are many patients, but the doctors and staff are working diligently. Keep up the good work!
